rationale: After stop preflight required reconsideration, inspect the remaining read-mode boundary rather than relabel the same stop. Retain newly acquired configuration and public read completion contracts with their actual response producers.

feedback.answered: Fresh source review distinguishes response production from public read completion. Safe reads normally register the committed index and caller context, locally acknowledge, broadcast context, and release queued read states when active-voter VoteResult reports a win; the singleton branch returns directly. Non-singleton requests wait for a current-term committed entry before entering either read mode. Lease mode returns the current committed index without a new per-request quorum exchange. Its configuration contract explicitly warns that unbounded clock drift/pause makes it unsafe, and Config validation rejects lease mode without CheckQuorum. Follower ForgetLeader is disabled in lease mode because it could allow a new election without the old leader knowing. responseToReadIndexReq either appends a local ReadState or sends a MsgReadIndexResp carrying the request entries; a follower requires exactly one entry before exposing its ReadState. The public Node contract requires application progress beyond the returned read index and caller correlation through RequestCtx before serving a read; receipt of ReadState alone is not application completion. The retry contract also contains version-qualified context reuse wording, so arbitrary repeated-context experiments cannot assume their permission. These are sourced mechanisms and caller duties, not measured read safety evidence.
remaining: A lease-safety check needs explicit tick/clock assumptions consistent with the documented fault contract; an arbitrary paused clock would be outside the advertised guarantee. No such environment model is selected.
Read completion must observe actual application progress and request identity; the existing configuration-admission harness has neither a read request nor a read endpoint.
Any context-reuse discriminator must first resolve the version-qualified retry permission against this captured implementation and inspect producers/consumers for that exact history.
Synchronous send-order normative precedence remains unresolved; the rejected bounded-completion preflight did not alter this fact or any accepted result.
feedback.rationale: This reconsideration adds concrete read boundaries instead of changing a stop label. It removes the tempting but unsupported inference that immediate lease ReadState delivery or delayed application alone is a read-safety violation. The next useful decision is whether a concrete in-contract read history and independent application endpoint can add evidence; otherwise retain these as explicit uncompleted scope in a reasoned early-stop comparison.
